renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: Stand in the firing line of want, anger, greed, fog, pride, envy — and make nothing happen there: the real stays put. See the world as a god-net cast wide, or a picture-book spinning — see all of it, see through all of it, and joy jumps up.

Don't plant the mind in pain, don't plant it in joy, don't scatter it anywhere — goddess: what sits in the middle can be known. Drop the standing in your own body and think everywhere-I-am-thus — gaze seeing nothing else: be happy.

Know pots and walls and longings as inside me — never born apart, never all-spreading: picturing this way, the all-going is born. Grasping and grasped run common to every body — the yogin's edge is the He-is, held with care.
Feel yourself in the other's body the way he feels knowing — drop your own-body-clinging and go spread-everywhere in days. Make the mind supportless — think no thoughts: Bhairava in the self.
All-knowing, all-doing — that one is me indeed, of Śiva-nature: held firm, turn Śiva. His world-plays show the way waves lift, flames lick, sunlight lands — mine and Bhairava's: nothing but showings.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: Post up in the blast zone of lust, rage, greed, fog, pride, envy — and cause nothing: the real remains. World as god-net or picture-whirl — see it all and joy spikes.
Mind parked nowhere — not in pain, not in joy, not scattered — goddess: the middle is knowable. Ditch the body-stand, run everywhere-I-am-thus — eyes on nothing else, happy mode.

Pots, walls, wants — all inside me, never born split, never fully spread: picture it that way and the all-going drops. Grasper and grasped, same stock in every body — the yogin's margin is the He-is, handled with care.
Yourself in the other guy's body, feeling what he feels as knowing — drop the own-body bias, go full-spread in days. Mind with no supports — zero thoughts: Bhairava in the self.
All-knowing, all-doing — that guy is me, Śiva-natured: locked in, go Śiva. World-plays like wave-sets, flame-flickers, sun-spill — mine and his: display only.
